integrity: The analytical argument establishes universal coefficients, whereas exact-rational and numerical checks test only finite instances. This is not independent peer validation.
scientific_limitations: Classical real, fixed-degree one-dimensional Bernstein iterates only; Jordan-variation norm on inputs whose two endpoint values match. Strict multi-iteration and fixed-degree Perron asymptotics do not resolve joint degree–iteration limits. Historical unindexed equivalences remain possible.
title: Sharp endpoint-anchored variation norms of iterated Bernstein operators
